stem.en: Choose the correct option for the gap: If I ___ more free time, I would learn to play the guitar.
stem.uz: Boʻsh joyga mos variantni tanlang: If I ___ more free time, I would learn to play the guitar.
stem.ru: Выберите вариант для пропуска: If I ___ more free time, I would learn to play the guitar.

why.en: Second conditional: if + past simple, would + verb.
why.uz: Ikkinchi tur shart gap: if + Past Simple, would + feʼl.
why.ru: Условие второго типа: if + Past Simple, would + глагол.

stem.en: Choose the correct option for the gap: By the time we reached the station, the train ___.
stem.uz: Boʻsh joyga mos variantni tanlang: By the time we reached the station, the train ___.
stem.ru: Выберите вариант для пропуска: By the time we reached the station, the train ___.

why.en: An action finished before another past action takes the past perfect.
why.uz: Oʻtmishdagi boshqa harakatdan oldin tugagan harakat Past Perfectda boʻladi.
why.ru: Действие, завершённое до другого в прошлом, – Past Perfect.

stem.en: Choose the correct option for the gap: She has been working at this hospital ___ 2019.
stem.uz: Boʻsh joyga mos variantni tanlang: She has been working at this hospital ___ 2019.
stem.ru: Выберите вариант для пропуска: She has been working at this hospital ___ 2019.

why.en: 'Since' goes with a starting point (2019); 'for' goes with a period.
why.uz: «Since» boshlanish nuqtasi bilan (2019), «for» davr bilan ishlatiladi.
why.ru: «Since» – с момента (2019), «for» – в течение периода.

stem.en: Choose the correct option for the gap: This old bridge ___ in 1890.
stem.uz: Boʻsh joyga mos variantni tanlang: This old bridge ___ in 1890.
stem.ru: Выберите вариант для пропуска: This old bridge ___ in 1890.

why.en: A bridge does not build itself: past simple passive.
why.uz: Koʻprik oʻzini oʻzi qurmaydi: Past Simple majhul nisbat.
why.ru: Мост не строит сам себя: пассив в Past Simple.

stem.en: Choose the correct option for the gap: He asked me where ___.
stem.uz: Boʻsh joyga mos variantni tanlang: He asked me where ___.
stem.ru: Выберите вариант для пропуска: He asked me where ___.

why.en: Reported questions use statement word order and shift the tense back.
why.uz: Oʻzlashtirma soʻroqda darak gap tartibi va zamon siljishi boʻladi.
why.ru: В косвенном вопросе прямой порядок слов и сдвиг времени.

stem.en: Choose the correct option for the gap: I'm looking forward to ___ you next week.
stem.uz: Boʻsh joyga mos variantni tanlang: I'm looking forward to ___ you next week.
stem.ru: Выберите вариант для пропуска: I'm looking forward to ___ you next week.

why.en: 'Look forward to' is followed by the -ing form.
why.uz: «Look forward to» dan keyin -ing shakli keladi.
why.ru: После «look forward to» нужна форма на -ing.

stem.en: Choose the correct option for the gap: This is ___ interesting book I have ever read.
stem.uz: Boʻsh joyga mos variantni tanlang: This is ___ interesting book I have ever read.
stem.ru: Выберите вариант для пропуска: This is ___ interesting book I have ever read.

why.en: 'Ever' after a superlative: the most interesting.
why.uz: «Ever» orttirma daraja bilan: the most interesting.
why.ru: «Ever» с превосходной степенью: the most interesting.

stem.en: Choose the correct option for the gap: Students ___ wear a uniform at our school; it is a rule.
stem.uz: Boʻsh joyga mos variantni tanlang: Students ___ wear a uniform at our school; it is a rule.
stem.ru: Выберите вариант для пропуска: Students ___ wear a uniform at our school; it is a rule.

why.en: A rule is an obligation: must.
why.ru: Правило – обязанность: must.

stem.en: Choose the correct option for the gap: Neither Aziz nor his brothers ___ at home yesterday.
stem.uz: Boʻsh joyga mos variantni tanlang: Neither Aziz nor his brothers ___ at home yesterday.
stem.ru: Выберите вариант для пропуска: Neither Aziz nor his brothers ___ at home yesterday.

why.en: With neither...nor the verb agrees with the nearer subject (brothers): were.
why.uz: Neither…nor da feʼl yaqinroq egaga (brothers) moslashadi: were.
why.ru: При neither…nor глагол согласуется с ближайшим подлежащим (brothers): were.

stem.en: Choose the correct option for the gap: I wish I ___ to the concert last night.
stem.uz: Boʻsh joyga mos variantni tanlang: I wish I ___ to the concert last night.
stem.ru: Выберите вариант для пропуска: I wish I ___ to the concert last night.

why.en: A regret about the past: wish + past perfect.
why.ru: Сожаление о прошлом: wish + Past Perfect.

stem.en: Choose the correct option for the gap: My mother is used to ___ up very early.
stem.uz: Boʻsh joyga mos variantni tanlang: My mother is used to ___ up very early.
stem.ru: Выберите вариант для пропуска: My mother is used to ___ up very early.

why.en: 'Be used to' (be accustomed to) takes the -ing form.
why.ru: «Be used to» (привык) – с формой на -ing.

stem.en: Choose the correct option for the gap: There isn't ___ milk left in the fridge.
stem.uz: Boʻsh joyga mos variantni tanlang: There isn't ___ milk left in the fridge.
stem.ru: Выберите вариант для пропуска: There isn't ___ milk left in the fridge.

why.en: Milk is uncountable: much.
why.ru: Milk – неисчисляемое: much.

stem.en: Choose the correct option for the gap: Kamola speaks English ___ than her sister.
stem.uz: Boʻsh joyga mos variantni tanlang: Kamola speaks English ___ than her sister.
stem.ru: Выберите вариант для пропуска: Kamola speaks English ___ than her sister.

why.en: 'Speaks' needs an adverb; 'than' needs the comparative.
why.ru: К «speaks» нужно наречие, к «than» – сравнительная степень.

stem.en: Choose the correct option for the gap: The man ___ car was stolen called the police.
stem.uz: Boʻsh joyga mos variantni tanlang: The man ___ car was stolen called the police.
stem.ru: Выберите вариант для пропуска: The man ___ car was stolen called the police.

why.en: Possession (his car) is shown by 'whose'.
why.ru: Принадлежность (его машина) – «whose».

stem.en: Choose the correct option for the gap: Let's go to the park after lunch, ___?
stem.uz: Boʻsh joyga mos variantni tanlang: Let's go to the park after lunch, ___?
stem.ru: Выберите вариант для пропуска: Let's go to the park after lunch, ___?

why.en: The tag after 'Let's' is 'shall we'.
why.ru: После «Let's» разделительный вопрос – «shall we».

stem.en: Choose the correct option for the gap: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ at home.
stem.uz: Boʻsh joyga mos variantni tanlang: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ at home.
stem.ru: Выберите вариант для пропуска: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ at home.

why.en: A real future condition: if + present, will + verb.
why.uz: Real kelasi shart: if + Present, will + feʼl.
why.ru: Реальное условие в будущем: if + Present, will + глагол.

stem.en: Choose the word closest in meaning to the word in capitals: The teacher was PLEASED with our project.
stem.uz: Katta harflar bilan yozilgan soʻzga maʼnodosh soʻzni tanlang: The teacher was PLEASED with our project.
stem.ru: Выберите слово, близкое по значению к слову, написанному заглавными буквами: The teacher was PLEASED with our project.

why.en: 'Pleased' means happy with something: satisfied.
why.ru: «Pleased» – довольный, т. е. satisfied.

stem.en: Choose the word opposite in meaning to the word in capitals: The street near our school is very NARROW.
stem.uz: Katta harflar bilan yozilgan soʻzga zid maʼnoli soʻzni tanlang: The street near our school is very NARROW.
stem.ru: Выберите слово, противоположное по значению слову, написанному заглавными буквами: The street near our school is very NARROW.

why.en: The opposite of narrow is wide.
why.ru: Противоположность «narrow» (узкий) – «wide» (широкий).

stem.en: Choose the correct option for the gap: I need to ___ a decision about my university before Friday.
stem.uz: Boʻsh joyga mos variantni tanlang: I need to ___ a decision about my university before Friday.
stem.ru: Выберите вариант для пропуска: I need to ___ a decision about my university before Friday.

why.en: The collocation is 'make a decision'.
why.ru: Устойчивое сочетание: «make a decision».

stem.en: Choose the correct option for the gap: Please turn ___ your phones during the exam.
stem.uz: Boʻsh joyga mos variantni tanlang: Please turn ___ your phones during the exam.
stem.ru: Выберите вариант для пропуска: Please turn ___ your phones during the exam.

why.en: 'Turn off' means stop a device working.
why.ru: «Turn off» – выключить.
